solutions.latex:
\exfigure{1266_q39_s1}

Looking at the original tasks $A - F$, we can see from the network diagram that the critical path is $ACDE$ with a minimum project time of 15 minutes.

Since $X$ cannot start until 6 minutes have elapsed, then it must have $A$ as an immediate prerequisite, and since no other tasks rely on $X$ as a prerequisite then we can draw an edge from $A$ to the End.

For the maximum possible duration without increasing the length of the project beyond 15 minutes then the LST for $X$ to start is 6 minutes (same as EST), giving a maximum duration of $15 - 6 = 9$ minutes.
